text:
I think u get maximum enjoyment from reading when u just stumble into some new author ass-backwards w/ no preconceived notions or biases

random example, prob 7-8 years ago fell into this passage below from Malcolm Muggeridge

remember reading it and being like…what the fuck

how do u pack that much erudition into a single paragraph

but having no idea who he was or how he was “regarded” etc, just searched his name on amzn and bought what popped up

fast forward, “chronicles of wasted time” is prob up there w/ my favorites ever

going thru the same w/ fernando pessoa right now, like literally just read that one paragraph in the QT and was gone…same reaction, like “wtf - no human is supposed to write that well”

this is where u end up reading and having it not feel like a chore or something u “should” do…just straight glued…have u staying up past ur bedtime and shit lol

always gotta remember reading is just 1v1…one man to another. some motherfucker sat down and put pen to paper and blasted it to the world. that’s all that’s ever gone on and all it will ever be

so whether “everyone else” likes it, or if the guy is “regarded,” who gives a fuck…if it speaks to u, then follow ur ❤️ and sprint towards it.

always seems to work out best that way, for some reason…
